rationales: Amoeba is not multicellular; it consists of a single cell.
Amoeba is unicellular because its one cell performs all life functions.
Amoeba is cellular, not acellular.
Amoeba does not form a colony of cells.
An experiment tests an idea rather than being a general statement.
A theory is a well-supported general statement that explains observations.
A hypothesis is a tentative explanation, not an established general statement.
A deduction is a prediction drawn from a hypothesis or theory.
Family is a lower taxonomic rank than kingdom.
Order is a lower taxonomic rank than kingdom.
Class is a lower taxonomic rank than kingdom.
Kingdom is the largest taxon listed.
Stomata do not cover as much as 1–8% of the leaf surface.
Stomata do not cover as much as 1–6% of the leaf surface.
Stomata do not cover as much as 1–4% of the leaf surface.
Stomata cover only about 1–2% of the leaf surface.
Nucleoplasm is the fluid inside the nucleus.
Stroma is the fluid-filled interior of a chloroplast.
Cytoplasm is the material inside the cell membrane, not specifically the chloroplast fluid.
Matrix is the fluid-filled interior of a mitochondrion.
A bivalent has four chromatids, not eight.
A bivalent consists of two homologous chromosomes and therefore has four chromatids.
Two is the number of chromosomes in a bivalent, not its chromatids.
A bivalent does not have only one chromatid.
Amylase is an enzyme, not a coenzyme.
Sodium ion is not the coenzyme intended here.
Glucose is a sugar, not a coenzyme.
Folic acid is a vitamin that functions as a coenzyme in metabolic reactions.
Dark reactions are not a part of respiration.
Dark reactions are part of photosynthesis and do not directly require light.
Glycolysis is a stage of respiration, not photosynthesis.
The Krebs cycle is a stage of respiration, not photosynthesis.
Lipids can provide energy but are not the basic energy source in animals.
Proteins are mainly used for growth and repair rather than as the basic energy source.
Carbohydrates are the basic and readily available energy source for animals.
Nucleic acids are not the basic energy source in animals.
Lipase digests fats and is not the main enzyme in saliva.
Salivary amylase begins the digestion of starch in the mouth.
Protease digests proteins and is not the main enzyme in saliva.
Trypsin is a pancreatic protein-digesting enzyme, not a salivary enzyme.
Phragmoplast formation occurs during cytokinesis in plant cells.
Animal cells form a cleavage furrow rather than a phragmoplast.
Phragmoplast formation is characteristic of plant-cell cytokinesis, not Protista generally.
Phragmoplast formation is not the characteristic division process of fungi.
Ribosomes do not contain their own DNA.
Lysosomes do not contain their own DNA.
Mitochondria contain their own DNA.
Golgi complexes do not contain their own DNA.
John Ray is associated with the species concept, not introducing the taxon of order.
Augustus Rivinus introduced the taxonomic category of order.
Tournefort is best known for developing the concept of genus.
Linnaeus established a hierarchical classification system but did not introduce the taxon of order.
A mosquito takes blood from the host rather than injecting it.
A female mosquito injects saliva, which helps prevent blood from clotting.
The mosquito does not inject a toxin as its usual feeding secretion.
The mosquito does not inject water when piercing the skin.
An organ system is a group of organs within an organism, not a forest.
An individual is one organism, not a forest.
A population consists of members of one species, whereas a forest contains many species.
A forest contains populations of many species living together, so it is a community.
